title: Human Expert Vs. AI on Lean 4 Proof Time: Measuring the Human-AI Gap and Identifying Where AI Helps Most

original_idea.body:
# Human Expert Vs. AI on Lean 4 Proof Time: Measuring the Human-AI Gap and Identifying Where AI Helps Most

**Problem:** No time comparison exists between expert humans and current AI (with/without AI assistance) on the same Lean 4 tasks. This gap analysis is fundamental for understanding where AI most accelerates formal verification.

**Direction:** Recruit 5 Lean 4 experts and 5 novices (CS students). Each solves 10 VeriBench tasks: (a) without AI assistance, (b) with Claude/Leanstral assistance. Measure time per task and success rate per condition. Compare to automated AI baseline (no human). Plot the human-AI collaboration efficiency frontier.

**Why it matters:** Understanding where human experts are still faster than AI, and where AI accelerates experts, is foundational for designing effective human-AI collaboration workflows for safety-critical formal verification.

**Relevant context:** No published study compares human expert and AI time on Lean 4 tasks. RAND calls for accelerating formal verification adoption. This user study would provide the empirical foundation for that recommendation.
